answer: New identities carry zero voting weight until 14 days old; afterwards each vote weighs one unit per day of age, capped at 100. A flash farm spinning up 500 shale accounts holds weight zero for two full weeks while paying hosting the entire time, and even half weight needs a months-long delta between registration and use. Velvet governance access cannot be bought in bulk at the moment of attack. An honest agent pays nothing extra - it simply ages into full weight.
